name: codex-worklog
description: Automatically append bounded local outcome summaries and recover task history when requested.

interface.shortDescription: Local what, when, and why for every task
interface.longDescription: Lifecycle hooks maintain an append-only semantic worklog without active-agent maintenance; a focused skill can inspect that history when context recovery is requested.
defaultPrompt: Recover task context from the workspace worklog and verify what is still true.
Check whether this plugin's local lifecycle hooks are installed and healthy.
